consequence.statement: UI bug fix: the parameter editor no longer resets when props update; no operational consequence for an operator is stated.

original.statement: UI bug fix: the parameter editor no longer resets when props update; no operator-facing configuration change is stated.

decision.reason: [ev-7967a77f6bd2] lists this under Changelog › Bug fixes as a UI-only fix: the parameter editor no longer resets when props update. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated. It also names no new default or changed behaviour for operators to check, only the removal of a UI defect. So "none" (informational) with low severity fits better than behavior-change.
